summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the new MEDICAL CERTIFICATE feature (DanoFitness23, React Native Web). Client flow (Home reminder banner -> profile card -> chunked upload of a PDF -> bonus +2 lottery tickets + confetti -> banner disappears -> date validation) and Admin flow (cert badge on user card, admin modal, expiry edit -> IN SCADENZA, delete -> NON CARICATO with badge sync) were all executed against the public preview URL. 8/8 requested scenarios passed after fixing one testability defect. Two real issues found (1 fixed in-scope, 1 reported).

ui_bugs.issue: Badge was rendered with the web prop `data-testid` on a react-native <View>; react-native-web drops unknown props so NO data-testid reached the DOM and the badge was not automatable. FIXED by testing agent: changed to testID for cert-badge-{userId} (both the 'valido' icon branch and the text badge branch). NOTE: 63 other `data-testid=` usages remain across /app/frontend/app (shop.tsx, admin.tsx pending-badge-{id}, trial-badge-{id}, etc.) and are equally invisible in the DOM - main agent should migrate them all to testID.

integration_issues.flow: Home KPI tickets counter after certificate bonus
integration_issues.issue: KPIBanner reads `l.biglietti` from GET /api/lottery/status, but the endpoint returns `biglietti_utente` (verified: API returned biglietti_utente=2 while Home KPI showed 0). Result: the +2 certificate bonus (and any lottery ticket) is never reflected in the Home KPI band; the number is permanently 0. Fix: use `biglietti_utente` in /app/frontend/src/components/KPIBanner.tsx (line ~35).

issues: Repeated console errors on the admin users list: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' (~25 occurrences) - stray whitespace/text inside a View in admin.tsx; cosmetic but pollutes logs.
Certificate card/banner colors, contrast, spacing and badge styling looked correct on desktop 1920x1080 (orange 'NON CARICATO', green 'VALIDO', yellow 'CERT IN SCAD.', orange 'NO CERT').

action_items: Fix KPIBanner: use `biglietti_utente` from /api/lottery/status so bonus tickets (incl. certificate +2) show on Home.
Migrate remaining `data-testid=` props on react-native components to `testID` (63 occurrences in /app/frontend/app) - they are stripped by react-native-web and break automated testing.
Remove the stray text node inside a <View> in admin.tsx causing repeated console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.tsx is ~3800 lines - should be split into smaller modules (users list, cert wiring, abbonamenti, etc.).
CertificatoCard.handleDone merges `res.certificato` with `bonus_gia_dato: true` locally instead of refetching /api/certificato/me; state is correct in practice but a refetch would be more robust.

Client-side date validation (parseDataIt) accepts any well-formed GG/MM/AAAA; e.g. 31/02/2027 would be normalized by JS Date - backend should be the source of truth (backend already validated separately).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 8 requested cert scenarios passed (after testID fix)

rca_of_the_issue: cert-badge not automatable: react-native-web only forwards its supported props (testID, dataSet, accessibility*) to the DOM; a raw `data-testid` JSX prop on <View> is silently discarded. Reproduced by querying document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]') on admin>Utenti: only cert-btn-{id} (which uses testID) was present. Fixed by switching the two cert badge Views to testID; verified badge then resolves and shows 'CERT IN SCAD.' / 'NO CERT'. Home ticket counter: field-name mismatch between API (biglietti_utente) and KPIBanner (biglietti).
